wiki.title: Elizabeth Wilson (politician)
wiki.extract: Elizabeth Wilson (born February 24, 1964) is an American politician and small business owner who has represented the 73rd district of the Iowa House of Representatives since January 2023, which consists of parts of central Linn County, including most of Marion. She is a member of the Democratic Party.
